title: feat(client): coalesce adjacent ranges in GcsBidiReadChannel.readVectored()

title: feat(core): serve vectored tail ranges from the cached footer in GcsFooterOptimizer

title: fix(client): short-circuit zero-length vectored ranges and validate offsets up front
hypothesis: A zero-length GcsObjectRange passed to GcsBidiReadChannel.readVectored() becomes RangeSpec.of(offset, 0), which java-storage interprets as 'read to EOF', so the caller receives the whole object tail instead of an empty buffer; GcsReadChannel opens an unnecessary ranged RPC for the same input, and a negative offset/length in the bidi path throws mid-loop leaving sibling futures hanging. Validating ranges up front and short-circuiting zero-length ranges with an empty buffer aligns both transports with the Hadoop/Iceberg tail-range edge cases.
learning: java-storage RangeSpec.of(offset, 0) means read-to-EOF: zero-length vectored ranges on the bidi path returned the whole object tail. Fixed with a shared VectoredIoUtil pre-validation helper (6 files/271 lines). Draft PR #406.

title: perf(client): avoid O(N^2) copying in VectoredIoUtil.mergeGcsObjectRanges
hypothesis: Accumulating merged underlying ranges lazily in a single ImmutableList.Builder per combined group inside VectoredIoUtil.mergeGcsObjectRanges (instead of calling GcsObjectCombinedRange.union on every step, which copies all prior ranges into a new ImmutableList and AutoValue instance each iteration) and using a static Comparator with ImmutableList.sortedCopyOf reduces range coalescing from O(N^2) time and allocation to O(N), proven by VectoredRangeCoalescingBenchmark.
learning: Replaced O(N^2) GcsObjectCombinedRange.union() copying and double-stream sorting in VectoredIoUtil.mergeGcsObjectRanges with primitive currentOffset/currentEnd tracking, lazy ImmutableList.Builder per coalesced group, and ImmutableList.sortedCopyOf(OFFSET_COMPARATOR, ranges). Improved all 9 VectoredRangeCoalescingBenchmark cases: up to -99.0% latency (2.71ms -> 27.2us, 100x faster) and -99.8% allocation (39.7MB -> 92.2KiB, 430x less memory) at ranges=4096, plus -21% to -44% on unmerged gapBytes=1048576 cases.

title: fix(client): short-circuit zero-length vectored ranges and validate offsets up front (PR #431)
hypothesis: Evaluate and respond to review feedback on PR #431
